summary: Nexera Technologies Ltd (formerly Jeffs' Brands Ltd) filed a Form 6-K disclosing that, effective September 3, 2026, the exercise price of its Series A Warrants (issued January 29, 2024) and a warrant issued June 18, 2026 in connection with a convertible promissory note was adjusted to $1.6148 per ordinary share, pursuant to anti-dilution provisions. No other modifications were made. This is a routine administrative adjustment of warrant terms, not a special situation. The filing incorporates by reference into various registration statements. What to watch: any further adjustments if the company issues additional securities. No deal terms applicable.
